answer: The lotus lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the relic is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the orchard of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
